label: Svelte 5 + SvelteKit (SPA mode) + runes
router: SvelteKit filesystem routing in SPA mode (root layout `ssr = false`, adapter-static with a 200.html fallback); plain <a href>, goto(), page.params from $app/state
state: a class with $state fields and $derived values in src/lib/catalog.svelte.ts, one module-level instance; favourites in a SvelteSet; filter inputs use function bindings
codeSplitting: SvelteKit splits by itself: one entry plus a node chunk per route and layout; first load fetches the entry, the root layout and the matched route
notes: Svelte's docs recommend SvelteKit for an app with routing; SvelteKit has no client-only mode without its own runtime, so the arm ships SvelteKit's client (router, data loading, preloading) as React Router ships its own.
app.html is the sv-create template's minus the favicon link; it keeps data-sveltekit-preload-data="hover" (no hover happens in the scripted session).
products is $state (deeply reactive, proxied lazily), as the docs write shared state; $state.raw would be a size-specific optimisation the contract excludes.
